description: Beyond the six active PC Frames, the Directorate's hangar holds a larger graveyard of legacy units — many already seriously damaged, decommissioned, or never successfully synced to anyone.
purposes: Give the setting history before session one.
Be a long-term technician-day sink: bringing one online is possible, and always costs something else.
Seed mystery — one of these units is plausibly tied to whoever was originally meant to pilot on Day 1.
Offer a possible replacement path if a PC's own Frame is ever permanently Hulked, without that having to be decided now.
